headline: Last session: Sensex slips 289 points on inflation concerns, but Nifty extends weekly rally to 3rd week

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on investor sentiment in the last trading session
Foreign fund inflows supported equity markets earlier in the week
Lower crude oil prices provided underlying support to domestic indices
Global market volatility and Nvidia crisis caused cautious momentum
whatHappening: Sensex fell 289 points in the last trading session while Nifty slipped on inflation worries
NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their weekly rally for the third straight week
PSU Banks featured as the top sectoral gainers during the week
Indian stock markets had seen massive gains earlier in the week with Rs 4.5 lakh crore investor wealth added
summary: In the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed lower due to inflation concerns, with Sensex dropping 289 points. Despite the drop, markets extended their weekly gain for the third consecutive week, led by PSU bank gains and foreign fund inflows. Markets remain closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 16 November.
